title: Design: Credit Hold banner and Change Bill To work on a phone
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Put (as an Admin) customer A on Credit Hold (Edit Customer, Credit Terms: Credit Hold).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-20-after-phone.png, bt-p3-21-after-phone-change-bill-to.png, bt-p3-19-before-phone.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Tap Change Bill To in the banner.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A red-outlined "Credit Hold" pill shows in the summary card.
  • The pink banner sits above the first line, its text wrapping over two lines, with "Change Bill To" at its bottom right.

Step 2:

  • The work order details open, scroll to the customer card and the Bill To list opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R6: “If the Bill To is on Credit Hold, the Credit Hold banner reads M2 with a "Change Bill To" button (work orders: page header; part sales: Finance tab).”
  • S7-R7: “"Change Bill To" opens and focuses the Customer card's Bill To field; on a phone it first opens the work order details.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Phone" (This build), "Phone, Change Bill To" (This build), "Phone" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

  • “Tapping "Change Bill To" opens the phone Details, scrolls to the Bill To field and opens its list”
